title: Ἐξήγησις εἰς τὸ Ἐπικτήτου Ἐγχειρίδιον — Simplicius, Commentary on Epictetus' Handbook (RU «Комментарий к „Энхиридию“ Эпиктета»)
author: Simplicius of Cilicia
edition: Schweighäuser 1800 and Dübner 1840, public domain: https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_72SHc8S-I5sC. I. Hadot, critical edition (Brill 1996; Budé), copyrighted.
ru_evidence: ruwiki Симпликий lists Russian extracts only from In Phys. I.1 (1998) and In De caelo II (2005). CyberLeninka search for an Encheiridion commentary translation returns nothing.
en_evidence: Brennan and Brittain, Simplicius: On Epictetus Handbook 1–26 and 27–53 (Duckworth 2002; Bloomsbury reissue), per enwiki and Open Library.
other_translations: French: I. Hadot, Budé (vol. I, chs. 1–29). English: Stanhope 1694.
value: A Neoplatonist reading of the most popular Stoic manual: what is 'up to us', moral education, and a theodicy against the Manichaeans (ch. 35). Epictetus has a large Russian readership; the text links Stoicism with late Platonism.
ai_feasibility: High. Expository, homiletic prose. The Epictetus lemmata already exist in Russian, and the English version allows cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Prologue plus chapter 1 ('up to us'), about 8k words; or chapter 35 (anti-Manichaean theodicy), about 6k words (estimates).
